page_sections.title: About DRAI
page_sections.content: We are a movement of Nigerian citizens committed to building a culture of integrity, accountability, and civic responsibility across our nation.
page_sections.subtitle: Our Story

page_sections.title: Our Core Values
page_sections.subtitle: These values guide everything we do and shape how we work with communities across Nigeria.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: Being honest, telling the truth and consistently upholding strong moral values and ethical standards.

values.title: Diligence
values.description: Working steadily and earnestly, and persevering until the goal is achieved.

values.title: Respect
values.description: Showing due regard for the feelings, wishes and rights of others.

values.title: Compassion
values.description: Recognising when others are in distress or suffering and taking action to help them.

values.title: Justice
values.description: Acting fairly and upholding what is morally right, both in how we treat people and in the causes we support.

values.title: Courage
values.description: Choosing to face pain, danger, uncertainty or intimidation in pursuit of a worthy goal.

values.title: Meritocracy
values.description: Building a society that values excellence, selects the most competent people for leadership and holds them accountable to the highest standards.

page_sections.title: Meet Our Team
page_sections.content: Meet the passionate DRAI team members who work tirelessly to promote integrity and civic responsibility across Nigerian communities. Together, we're building a movement that transforms lives and strengthens democracy.
page_sections.subtitle: The passionate individuals behind DRAI's mission to promote integrity and accountability across Nigeria.

page_sections.title: Our Mission
page_sections.content: To promote integrity, accountability, and civic responsibility across Nigeria through education, advocacy, and community-led action, creating sustainable change from the grassroots up. We believe that lasting transformation comes from empowering citizens with the knowledge, tools, and networks needed to demand and create positive change in their communities.

page_sections.title: Our Vision
page_sections.content: A Nigeria where integrity is the norm, where citizens actively participate in governance, and where transparent, accountable leadership drives sustainable development for all. We envision communities empowered to hold their leaders accountable, institutions that serve the public interest, and a culture where doing right is celebrated and rewarded.

page_sections.title: Our Journey
page_sections.subtitle: Key milestones in our mission to promote integrity and accountability across Nigeria.

timeline.title: Foundation
timeline.description: Doing Right Awareness Initiative (DRAI) was founded by a group of passionate Nigerian citizens committed to promoting integrity and accountability.

timeline.title: First Community Programs
timeline.description: Launched our first youth mentorship programs in Lagos and Abuja, reaching over 500 young leaders.

timeline.title: Digital Expansion
timeline.description: Developed our first online training platform and launched digital reporting tools for citizens.

timeline.title: National Reach
timeline.description: Expanded operations to 15 states across Nigeria, establishing local chapters and partnerships.

timeline.title: Policy Impact
timeline.description: Our advocacy efforts contributed to 12 policy reforms at local and state government levels.

timeline.title: Comprehensive Platform
timeline.description: Launched our complete training and certification system, serving over 5,000 active learners.

page_sections.title: How We Create Change
page_sections.content: Our integrated approach combines community mobilization with institutional engagement, creating sustainable change from the grassroots up while influencing policy at the highest levels.
